verdict.rationale: WezTerm's `cli` subcommand drives a running GUI or mux instance to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes. A hands-on probe confirmed a fully headless loop (spawn, send-text, get-text, list) with no GUI session, and the community confirms get-text scrollback dumping. Configuration can also be changed through the auto-reloaded Lua config and command-line overrides. However, nothing shows that every UI capability is exposed programmatically. Missing for 10: documented UI/API parity for interactive features (search mode, Quick Select, copy modes, font-size/color changes at runtime via the CLI), a comprehensive API reference beyond pane/tab/window manipulation, and independent confirmation of complete coverage.
